claim_text: Six people connected to Brava Restaurant & Cafe LLC (Rochester), an extended Jama family group charged in No. 22-CR-225 in the Feeding Our Future prosecutions, have the following updated dispositions, none reflected in this corpus's defendants.json or DEFENDANTS.md prior to this pass: Sharmake Jama pleaded guilty January 29, 2025; Ayan Jama pleaded guilty either January 31, 2025 (Post Bulletin) or February 3, 2025 (CBS News) -- an unresolved minor date discrepancy -- and admitted using more than $775,000 in program funds for personal expenditures including property in Turkey and homes in Rochester and Columbus, Ohio; Zamzam Jama pleaded guilty February 5, 2025 to money laundering and was later sentenced (reported by April 1, 2026) to six months in prison and $491,245 restitution; Mustafa Jama and Asha Jama both entered guilty pleas to money laundering, reported by February 7, 2025; and Fartun Jama's case was terminated following her 2023 death, per court records described in Sahan Journal's defendant roster.

supporting_passages.quote: Sharmake Jama... pleaded guilty on January 29, 2025... Ayan Jama... pleaded guilty on January 31, 2025... Zamzam Jama... pleaded guilty to money laundering on February 5, 2025

supporting_passages.locator: Sahan Journal defendant roster, entry for Fartun Jama
supporting_passages.quote: Court records from July 2023 show that Fartun has since died.

amounts.methodology: Zamzam Jama's restitution, reported by KTTC; no primary judgment captured.

qualifiers: No primary court record (plea agreement, judgment, sentencing minute) has been captured for any of these six defendants; all six dispositions here rest on secondary journalism.
Ayan Jama's plea date is reported inconsistently across two outlets (January 31 vs. February 3, 2025); preserved as an open discrepancy, not resolved.
No sentencing information was found for Sharmake Jama, Ayan Jama, Mustafa Jama, or Asha Jama in this pass; only Zamzam Jama's sentencing has been located.

Fartun Jama's death and case termination is reported only through Sahan Journal's roster note quoting unspecified 'court records from July 2023'; the underlying court record itself has not been independently retrieved.

This is a sensitive fact (a defendant's death); do not embellish beyond what is stated, and do not speculate about cause or manner of death beyond 'died' / 'natural causes' as separately reported elsewhere.
editorial_notes: Fourth finding in the freshness/disposition-reconciliation pass. All six of these defendants were previously listed as 'charged' with only their original 2022-09-20 charge date in defendants.json and DEFENDANTS.md, despite these guilty pleas dating to January-February 2025 -- more than a year and a half of staleness in the corpus's own case-status tracking for this sub-family.
